page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes two bundled NVIDIA P4 GPUs, delivering a total of 16 GB of VRAM to accelerate parallel computing tasks.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring moderate GPU acceleration alongside substantial CPU resources.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge offers a balanced resource profile for legacy GPU workloads. Because it utilizes older-generation NVIDIA P4 GPUs, it provides a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated tasks that do not require the massive memory bandwidth or tensor cores of newer architectures. Appropriate workloads include video transcoding, machine learning inference, and parallel data processing.
